stories.headline: US and Israel strike Iran's Natanz nuclear enrichment facility; IAEA confirms no radiation leak

key_facts.fact: Iran's Natanz nuclear enrichment facility was hit by a US-Israeli airstrike on Saturday March 21, marking the second strike on the facility during the three-week conflict
key_facts.excerpt: Iran's main enrichment facility was hit with an airstrike Saturday, the official Iranian news agency Mizan reported

key_facts.fact: The IAEA confirmed the attack on the facility and reported no radiation leakage
key_facts.excerpt: IAEA: Iran's Natanz nuclear-enrichment site attacked

key_facts.fact: No radiation leakage was detected at the facility, which is approximately 135 miles south of Tehran
key_facts.excerpt: No radiation leakage was reported, according Iran's official news agency

key_facts.fact: The Trump administration is strategizing methods to secure or extract Iran's nuclear materials following the strike
key_facts.excerpt: The Trump administration is strategizing methods and options to secure or extract Iran's nuclear materials

key_facts.fact: Iran's atomic energy organization confirmed the US-Israeli attack on the Natanz uranium facility
key_facts.excerpt: US, Israel strike Iran's Natanz uranium facility: Iran atomic energy organisation

stories.headline: Iranian missiles strike Israeli towns near Dimona nuclear center, wounding nearly 100

key_facts.fact: Iranian missiles hit the southern Israeli towns of Dimona and Arad on March 21, causing approximately 30 injuries in Dimona and 64 wounded in Arad
key_facts.excerpt: Dimona sustained approximately 30+ injuries, while Arad saw around 64 people wounded

key_facts.fact: Both Dimona and Arad are located near Israel's main nuclear research center
key_facts.excerpt: Both towns neighbor Israel's main nuclear research center

key_facts.fact: Iran has retaliated with remaining missiles and armed drones as the US deploys additional Marines and sailors to the Middle East
key_facts.excerpt: Israel and Iran launch more attacks as US sends marines to Middle East

key_facts.fact: The Pentagon has prepared detailed plans for potential US ground force deployment into Iran, though Trump indicated considering 'winding down' operations
key_facts.excerpt: Pentagon officials prepared detailed plans for potential U.S. ground force deployment into Iran

stories.headline: IEA warns Iran war is 'greatest energy security threat in history'; disruption surpasses 1970s crises

key_facts.fact: IEA chief Fatih Birol told the Financial Times the Iran war represents 'the greatest threat to global energy security in history'
key_facts.excerpt: Iran war is greatest threat to global energy 'in history,' warns IEA

key_facts.fact: Oil supply disruption has already surpassed losses from both the 1973 and 1979-1980 oil shocks, with roughly 20% of global oil and gas supplies stranded
key_facts.excerpt: Oil supply disruption exceeded the losses of the crises of the 1970s

key_facts.fact: Gas disruption is double the amount Europe lost after Russian supply cuts in 2022; 400 million barrels have been released from strategic reserves
key_facts.excerpt: Twice as much gas is currently offline compared to Europe's 2022 Russian gas cutoff; 400 million barrels released from strategic reserves

key_facts.fact: Birol said recovery could take 'six months for some sites to be operational, others much longer' even if the conflict ends soon
key_facts.excerpt: Recovery of oil and gas fields in Gulf region could take more than 6 months

key_facts.fact: Vital arteries have halted, affecting supplies of fertilizers, petrochemicals, sulfur, and helium deemed essential to global economic functioning
key_facts.excerpt: Vital arteries have come to a halt, affecting supplies of fertilizers, petrochemicals, sulfur, and helium

stories.headline: Oil closes at highest since 2022 as Strait of Hormuz stays shut; Brent above $110

key_facts.fact: Brent crude rose above $110 per barrel on March 20, a 48% increase since the war began, closing at the highest level since 2022
key_facts.excerpt: Oil Closes at Highest Since 2022 on Outlook for Prolonged War

key_facts.fact: Oil posted its fifth consecutive weekly gain amid Middle East escalation fears
key_facts.excerpt: Oil Up 5th Straight Week on Middle East Escalation Fear

key_facts.fact: The Strait of Hormuz has remained effectively closed to most commercial shipping since late February, blocking roughly 20% of global oil supply (~20 million barrels per day)
key_facts.excerpt: The effective closure of the Strait of Hormuz during the Iran war has choked global oil supply

key_facts.fact: Saudi Arabia's East-West Pipeline surged from 750,000 to 2.5 million barrels/day; UAE's Fujairah terminal spiked to 2.25 million barrels/day before declining following drone strikes
key_facts.excerpt: If both Yanbu and Fujairah were compromised, moving oil out of the Arabian Peninsula would become 'virtually impossible'

key_facts.fact: US gasoline averaged $3.91 per gallon as energy costs rose across the board
key_facts.excerpt: U.S. gasoline averaged $3.91 per gallon

stories.headline: Russia begins Spring-Summer 2026 offensive against Ukraine's Fortress Belt in Donetsk

key_facts.fact: ISW assessed on March 21 that Russian forces have 'likely begun their anticipated Spring-Summer 2026 offensive against the Ukrainian Fortress Belt,' Ukraine's main defensive line in Donetsk Oblast
key_facts.excerpt: Russian forces have likely begun their anticipated Spring-Summer 2026 offensive against the Ukrainian Fortress Belt

key_facts.fact: Russia intensified ground operations in the Lyman direction to advance on Slovyansk, the northern tip of the Fortress Belt, from the northeast
key_facts.excerpt: intensified ground operations in the Lyman direction to advance on Slovyansk, the northern tip of the Fortress Belt

key_facts.fact: ISW observed increased Russian mechanized assaults across multiple sectors since March 17, including company-sized assaults toward Novopavlivka
key_facts.excerpt: Russian forces are increasingly conducting mechanized assaults on the frontline, possibly as part of intensified preparation for their Spring-Summer 2026 offensive

key_facts.fact: Russian casualties roughly doubled from ~800/day to ~1,500-1,700/day when the offensive launched around March 17-18, with over 900 casualties in one sector in 36 hours
key_facts.excerpt: March 18-19: ~1,710-1,520 Russian casualties, roughly doubled from baseline winter rates

key_facts.fact: Ukraine countered with thermal drones that penetrate fog and surged mid-range strikes (50-250km) from 11/month to 45/month since November 2025, while Russia resorted to motorcycles and ATVs as supply lines depleted
key_facts.excerpt: Thermal drones that penetrate fog, negating Russia's weather advantage; mid-range strikes surged from 11/month to 45/month

key_facts.excerpt: Trump declared the battle 'Militarily WON' on Friday, yet contradictions emerged

key_facts.fact: A White House official claimed Iran's top leaders eliminated, most of its navy destroyed, and its ballistic missile arsenal largely decimated
key_facts.excerpt: Iran's top leaders eliminated, most of its navy destroyed, and its ballistic missile arsenal largely decimated

key_facts.fact: Trump called NATO countries 'cowards' for refusing to help secure the Strait of Hormuz
key_facts.excerpt: He called NATO countries 'cowards' for refusing to help secure the Strait of Hormuz

key_facts.fact: Analysts noted the administration 'failed to think through contingencies around ways a conflict with Iran could go sideways'

stories.headline: Earendil Labs raises $787M to scale AI-driven biologics discovery with Sanofi partnership

key_facts.fact: Earendil Labs raised $787 million in financing from investors including Dimension Capital, DST Global, INCE Capital, Sanofi, and the Biotech Development Fund (Hillhouse-Pfizer partnership)
key_facts.excerpt: Earendil Labs raised $787 million in financing rounds with participation by leading global investors including Dimension Capital, DST Global, INCE Capital

key_facts.fact: The company has generated over 40 programs including HXN-1001, a half-life extended anti-TL1A antibody ready for Phase 2, and HXN-1002/1003 bispecific antibodies licensed to Sanofi
key_facts.excerpt: Over 40 programs including HXN-1001 ready for Phase 2 and HXN-1002 and HXN-1003 licensed to Sanofi

key_facts.fact: The Sanofi collaboration includes an exclusive worldwide license agreement for autoimmune and inflammatory disease programs
key_facts.excerpt: Sanofi collaboration includes an exclusive worldwide license agreement and broader strategic collaboration

key_facts.fact: Earendil integrates AI across the entire biologics R&D lifecycle, focusing on autoimmune diseases, inflammatory bowel disease, and cancer
key_facts.excerpt: AI-driven biotechnology company advancing next-generation biologics

key_facts.fact: The company was founded by Jian Peng, PhD (CEO) and Zhenping Zhu, MD, PhD (Co-CEO), and plans multiple IND submissions for 2026-2027
key_facts.excerpt: Jian Peng, PhD, Founder and CEO; Zhenping Zhu, MD, PhD, Co-Founder, President, and Co-CEO

stories.headline: FDA approves Rhythm Pharma's Imcivree as first treatment for acquired hypothalamic obesity

key_facts.fact: The FDA approved Imcivree (setmelanotide) for weight management in adults and children aged 4+ with acquired hypothalamic obesity, a rapid weight-gain syndrome after hypothalamic injury
key_facts.excerpt: The melanocortin 4 receptor agonist setmelanotide is now FDA approved for weight management in adults and children with acquired hypothalamic obesity

key_facts.fact: This is the first FDA-approved treatment for acquired hypothalamic obesity, which often develops after treatment for hypothalamic-pituitary tumors
key_facts.excerpt: Rhythm Pharma Wins FDA Approval For First-Ever Rare Weight Disorder Therapy

key_facts.fact: Clinical trial results showed setmelanotide significantly reduces BMI and hunger in patients with acquired hypothalamic obesity
key_facts.excerpt: Clinical trial results indicate that setmelanotide significantly reduces BMI and hunger in patients with acquired HO

key_facts.fact: The FDA also approved Imcivree for patients aged 2+ with syndromic or monogenic obesity due to Bardet-Biedl syndrome or POMC/PCSK1/leptin receptor deficiency
key_facts.excerpt: FDA also approved Imcivree in adult and pediatric patients aged 2 years and older with syndromic or monogenic obesity due to Bardet-Biedl syndrome
